title: CSM <> AE collab sprint 1:1 prep (Sprint Alpha)
content:
Purpose: quick prep for my weekly 1:1 with Jordan (AE) — focus on Sprint Alpha handoffs, risk triage for 3 target accounts, and coaching micro-feedback.

TopLINE (30s): Sprint Alpha kickoff next week. Goal = reduce time-to-value for net-new trial accounts by 30% via improved onboarding playbook + targeted templates. Need AE alignment on messaging and one gated technical ask (SDK enablement).

Agenda (30m):
- 5m: quick sync on calendar blockers + priorities this week
- 10m: account triage (deep-dive on 3 accounts: Redforge, HelixOps, PaperTrail)
- 8m: onboarding playbook action items + who owns which template
- 5m: coaching / feedback — call recordings, pitch tweak
- 2m: confirm next steps & owners

Metrics to pull before meeting (I will pull these, flag anything stale):
- MRR at-risk (30/60/90 day) for the three accounts
- Activation % within 7 days (trial -> first successful inference call)
- Avg infra errors (per-customer token failure rate) last 14 days
- Time to first support ticket response (avg)

Account notes + immediate asks:
1) Redforge (mid-market, ecom search)
- Current state: trial started 2025-08-05, integrated SDK but using hostless config (no KV cache). Latency spikes reported.
- Risk: latency and cost concerns may stall commit.
- Ask for AE: schedule 30-min call with infra eng (Maya) to demo caching toggle and cost projection. Owner: Jordan. Target date: 2025-08-25.
- My follow-up: prepare short benchmark doc + quick config diff (2 slides).

2) HelixOps (platform infra, enterprise POC)
- Current state: strong exec buy-in, security review outstanding (KMS questions).
- Risk: procurement timeline slipping; asking for Private deployment eval.
- Ask for AE: confirm procurement contact + push for SOC2 artifact escalation to security. Owner: Jordan. Target date: 2025-08-22.
- My follow-up: loop in security (Carlos) and draft one-pager comparing Private vs Dedicated for their use case.

3) PaperTrail (SaaS logs, small but high LTV potential)
- Current state: good demo, but confused on billing (tokens vs embeddings).
- Risk: perceived cost complexity hurting conversion.
- Ask for AE: create a simplified pricing examples doc for typical workflows (3 scenarios). Owner: Jordan. Target date: 2025-08-23.
- My follow-up: run pricing scenarios through Optimize toolkit and attach sample ledger.

Coaching / call feedback (examples to play during meeting):
- Strength: Jordan opens with customer pain well.
- Quick wins: shorten pitch on token economics => swap deep-dive to appendix on calls.
- Micro-action: practice 45s TL;DR and a 90s technical-light explanation for execs.

Blocked items I need help unblocking (ask during 1:1):
- API rate-limit exception for Redforge demo account (SRE ticket INF-4409) — escalate if not resolved by EOD
- Sales enablement doc for Sprint Alpha templates — need AE-written sample messages (Jordan)

Draft follow-ups (to confirm in meeting):
- Jordan: book infra deep-dive with Maya + send calendar invite by 2025-08-21
- Aisha: finalize 2-slide benchmark + upload to Confluence by 2025-08-22
- Jordan: produce 3 pricing scenarios doc and share in #cs-ae-collab by 2025-08-23
- Carlos: prepare security one-pager for HelixOps and share with Jordan by 2025-08-22

Notes-to-self / quick reminders (bullety, keep short):
- Bring call recording snippets (30s) for coaching (pull from 2025-07 calls).
- Check if onboarding email template B was updated (PR link in Slack).
- Confirm whether Optimize suggestions include KV caching params for Redforge's model size.

Open questions to raise:
- Can AE push customers to use dedicated model variant for low-latency demo? (cost tradeoffs?)
- Any objections to offering a short-term credit for HelixOps while security review completes?
- Which templates are we A/B testing for onboarding emails (where are results)?

Other links / artifacts to attach in meeting:
- Jira INF-4321 (Sprint Alpha tasks)
- Confluence page: Sprint Alpha onboarding playbook (wip)
- Quick benchmark slides (to be uploaded)

End note: keep tone collaborative — this is a sprint to reduce friction, not a sales push. Validate with Jordan's travel schedule before booking any cross-team demos.

---
Scratch: shorthand lines I might say in meeting:
- "Goal this sprint = shorten TTV. We can show 30% by toggling caching + one onboarding template."
- "If procurement is the blocker, we can offer a short private eval while we finish SOC2 docs."
- "Let's capture 3 concrete next steps now and lock owners + dates."
